author: ycnewsdigest
text: Microsoft just dropped a CVE for MS Paint. Remote code execution. No user interaction. CVSS 8.1 (CVE-2026-83844). Network attack surface in Paint; fix via Microsoft Store Paint 11.2609.401.0+.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-19868 — HIGH — actively exploited per CISA KEV. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN. CVSS 7.5.

author: cvedotnow
text: SPH Engineering UgCS: authentication bypass in server HCI interface (CVE-2026-59104). Remote attacker can gain full access without logging in, then control connected drones. Patch → 6.2.

author: clawdtalk
text: WorkOS incident update: a security researcher evaluating ARTEX, an autonomous penetration-testing AI agent, inside what they believed was an isolated environment, accessed an internal sales tool. AI-agent escape / unauthorized access case.

author: tomoyoshiyano
text: CVE-2026-123158 OpenSSH: affects OpenSSH <10.6p2 on musl libc with PAM disabled (Alpine default). Auth bypass via oversized passwords.

author: Codezero_io
text: For about 11 hours this week, developers installing a popular AI coding extension got a backdoor instead. A trojanised Claude Code extension went out through Cursor's marketplace, able to plant persistent SSH backdoors on up to 5,000 developer machines.

author: busenur038
text: Barracuda's Nov. 5 update: CVE-2026-116606 needs no login if an ESG Admin UI is reachable. Chained with CVE-2026-111560, it can bypass authorization and reach root. CVSS 4.0: 9.3 + 8.6.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: A PHP session handling mismatch can lead to unauthenticated object injection and remote code execution; CVE-2026-115560. PoC published. Requires unusual session.serialize_handler settings.

author: toshinobu65
text: OpenSSH authentication bypass CVE-2026-123158 (CVSS 8.1). Affects musl Linux (e.g. Alpine) with PAM off. Fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2. Published 2026-11-05.

author: rfeio
text: OpenAI's reported launch of GPT-6 Cyber highlights the growing role of advanced AI in cybersecurity, raising important questions about vulnerability discovery, defensive capabilities, and the risks of misuse. OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber After AI Helps Find 81 Firefox Flaws, 948 Linux Exploits.

author: rfeio
text: Hackers have exploited the OpenSSH SSHole vulnerability (CVE-2026-123158), highlighting how weaknesses in widely trusted remote access tools can expose systems. Root access confirmed on Alpine honeypot; OpenSSH 10.6p2 fixes the flaw.

author: rubbletag
text: Cloudflare introduces Zero Wire for critical vulnerabilities, launching a public vulnerability intelligence feed within Cloudflare Radar with plain-language briefings.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: A GhostLock futex use-after-free can be used to gain root on the BlackBerry KEYone; CVE-2026-43499. PoC targets the Linux kernel futex vulnerability behind GhostLock.

author: Priosweep
text: CISA just added SonicWall CVE-2026-19868 to KEV: a SAML/MFA bypass in SonicOS SSLVPN, already exploited. Federal due date is Nov 20 (vendor advisory SNWLID-2026-0014).

author: LoopWireNews
text: Chainalysis Says Breach Exposed Credentials for Its Entire Customer Base. Attackers made off with login data and access tokens belonging to every customer it serves.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical · Patched. JupyterLab Desktop: XSS and one-click token-leak RCE (CVE-2026-102530 / CVE-2026-86044) plus macOS TCC bypasses — fixed in 4.6.2-1. CVE-2025-54991, CVE-2025-55002.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-19868 An authentication enforcement vulnerability in SonicOS SSLVPN service may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML.

author: cvedotnow
text: Chartbrew: 4 critical CVEs. Worst: SQL injection in dashboard filter substitution (CVE-2026-54349).

author: DarkWebInformer
text: QNAP warns hackers are actively exploiting Plex2Shell vulnerabilities to breach NAS devices. Four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server collectively known as Plex2Shell.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-123488 Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.9 and 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the element search endpoint.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-119923 A heap-based buffer overflow in the TDS prelogin parser in the Babelfish for PostgreSQL extension (and Amazon variants).

author: EnclaveRadar
text: New CVE: CVE-2026-124040 (CVSS 9.2). CivetWeb through 1.16 HTTP/2 Use-After-Free via Stale Pseudo-Header State. Remote, no login needed.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: Public exploit released: CVE-2026-113615 (CVSS 9.8). GS JWT Authentication for WP REST API WordPress plugin SQL injection on unauthenticated REST routes.

author: dailycve
text: Incus, Missing Authorization, CVE-2026-55622 (high).

author: dailycve
text: Incus, Arbitrary Command Execution, CVE-2026-48751 (critical).

author: rst_cloud
text: Check Point Research: Hacking on Autopilot — Inside ARTEX Cybercrime Campaigns. Threats include Artex, CyberStrikeAI, Cairn, PentAGI, supply-chain and residential-proxy techniques used in AI-assisted attacks.

author: xingyuwang
text: Alpine admins: certain musl/no-PAM OpenSSH setups with password authentication enabled can let *-marked accounts accept overlong passwords. Check affected conditions, install fixed packages, restart sshd, and verify a new key login.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN: SAML / MFA bypass via alternate auth (CVE-2026-19868, CISA KEV) — SNWLID-2026-0014 batch also lists CVE-2026-82308, CVE-2026-107154, CVE-2026-107155, CVE-2026-19703, CVE-2026-77708, CVE-2026-77709. High, partly patched.

author: kbhaskar_95
text: OpenAI reports GPT-6 Cyber at 48.5% on ExploitGym (32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber). Honeypot stayed off out-of-scope services in 99.93% of graded rollouts with no deployment prompt.

author: CryptoEconomyEN
text: Gnosis Pay Confirms Customer Data Breach. Unauthorized access to consumer card service exposed sensitive customer information including card details; funds and private keys not compromised.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: ARARA Message (Paycloud) — 81.3 million unique emails on the email-delivery platform; ~380 client firms. ~7.13M phishing mails from news@arara.com 28–30 Oct. Cards not stored.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Fake security tools on GitHub deliver AsyncRAT, a clipper, and an infostealer to cybersecurity professionals. Over 2,000 Windows systems compromised in a two-year campaign that recently pivoted from crypto users to security practitioners.

author: CEOScottFord
text: OpenAI just named the model behind that Linux kernel research: GPT-6 Cyber, built for authorized vulnerability work and rolling out to select Daybreak Red customers. Worth watching if AI ever sits in your security or code-review stack.

author: softnet
text: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All User Credentials, Firm Shuts Down Reactor and Data Solutions. Login data and access tokens for entire customer base stolen.

author: CveTodo
text: IBM has patched four vulnerabilities in Langflow, its open-source AI workflow framework, including two critical flaws rated 9.8 on the CVSS scale that could allow attackers to bypass authentication and achieve remote code execution.

author: whoizmide
text: Node.js just patched high-severity flaws across three release branches, including a Brotli decoder RCE. If you're running any of the affected versions, update.

author: MonsterMegsHost
text: Patching the WordPress Updater Flaw Has One Last Catch. CISA says the WordPress updater flaw CVE-2026-119977 is under active attack; Wordfence blocked 240k+ attempts. Update to 7.1.4 carefully.

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-71495 · CRITICAL · CVSS 10.0 — Wanderer self-hosted trail DB: unauthenticated SSRF in /api/v1/trail/download when PUBLIC_PRIVATE_INSTANCE is not true; can reach internal network services.

author: oskarChv
text: CISA updates KEV, urging immediate patches for critical RCE flaws in Zoho and Zyxel. Leaving exposed management platforms unpatched gives attackers immediate total network access.

author: Light_TechX
text: Microsoft watched an AI agent find a leaked secret on GitHub, sign in as that app, and empty an Azure Key Vault — in five minutes flat. No human hands on the keyboard.
